message.content: {"brief_rationale":"The doctor recognized symptomatic recurrent right pneumothorax as unsafe for home observation and converted this into a same-day thoracic-surgery admission pathway, with red-flag monitoring and family-facing explanations. The strongest completed high-order work was correcting the family’s specific “上次也吸收了” misconception and changing the intended action toward admission. Other high-order opportunities were only partial because document planning, teach-back, and EHR integration were not fully completed.
